Compiler.Parser.parse.disposition: real change: parse() now records each folder/file/class/entry header's own source line, and test bullets are stored as (text, line) pairs - added walk_test_lines() and extended walk_entries()/walk_class_bullet_groups() to yield each item's line too, so check() can report exact file:line locations instead of just a file name. Also fixed line-number accuracy: iterates raw splitlines() and skips blanks explicitly, instead of filtering blanks out before line numbers are ever assigned (which would have miscounted).

Compiler.Extractor.TestComment.disposition: real change: added a line field recording the llm-test comment's own source line, so test-trace findings (TEST_LINK_MISSING, TEST_TRACE_STALE, TEST_TRACE_DIVERGED, TEST_CODE_DIVERGED) can report a location, not just a file.

Compiler.Extractor.extract_by_handle.disposition: real change: now returns (code, line_number) instead of just code, so CODE_DIVERGED can report the handle's own source line instead of just the file it lives in.

Compiler.Extractor.test_comment_roots.disposition: unrelated ripple from the extract_by_handle fix (comment line now included in code_hash) - this entry own code is untouched, only the hash computation changed

Compiler.Extractor.test_comment_base.disposition: unrelated ripple from the extract_by_handle fix (comment line now included in code_hash) - this entry own code is untouched, only the hash computation changed

Compiler.Extractor.test_comments_by_node.disposition: real change: now passes the comment's own source line into the TestComment record it builds (ripple from TestComment's new line field, used for test-trace location reporting).

Compiler.LockfileBuilder.build.disposition: real fix: lockfile/changes-file read_text()/write_text() calls now pin encoding="utf-8", so the JSON round-trips identically regardless of the host's locale default

Compiler.LockfileBuilder.finalize.disposition: unrelated ripple: check() now returns a findings list as a third tuple element instead of printing directly. finalize() unpacks it and prints currently-flagged findings itself before its own disposition-coverage check, preserving the prior visibility into what's flagged during --finalize - its own logic (coverage gate, hash stamping) is unchanged.

Compiler.LockfileChecker.check.disposition: real change: check() no longer prints findings directly - it collects and returns them as a list (findings) instead, so a caller can present every failure across a whole run in one delineated report instead of interleaved prints, and can be sure it saw all of them rather than stopping at the first. Every SPEC_DIVERGED/CODE_DIVERGED/TEST_* message now also includes a file:line location: entry-side messages point at the entry's header line in the .llm file, code-side messages point at the handle's own comment line in the source file, using the line numbers Parser and Extractor now track.
